rules.sentence: A laparoscopic approach is safe and effective for treating uncomplicated appendicitis and may also be safely performed in cases of perforated appendicitis.
Patients who have undergone appendectomy for complicated appendicitis are advised to have a longer hospital admission period of about 5 to 7 days.
